payload_json.loop: Deploy Lightning Sentry traps at key positions (sentry emits 10 lightning shots). Use Teleport (via Enigma runeword) to reposition rapidly. When opponent enters range, stun them with Mind Blast. Whirlwind through stunned target for physical/elemental damage burst. Traps continue firing during WW. Control-chain dueling identity.
